description: Project plan with critical path — Turn a goal into a dated project plan: AI drafts phases, tasks, durations, dependencies and roles, then the schedule is computed offline with the critical path method: early start/finish, slack, critical path, start/finish dates skipping weekends and US federal holidays, milestones with dates, effort by role, parallelism and a FITS/TIGHT/OVER verdict vs your target weeks. Cycles and unknown dependencies are repaired and reported. Optional: weeks, team (roles), start (YYYY-MM-DD), calendar=us|none. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

goal.description: e.g. Launch a mobile app MVP for booking dog walkers
